title: Why Bees Matter
text: Bees do much more than make honey. As they travel from flower to flower collecting nectar, they carry pollen that helps plants produce fruits, vegetables, and seeds. Without this pollination, many of the foods we eat every day, like apples, almonds, and strawberries, would become scarce and expensive. Unfortunately, bee populations have been shrinking due to disease, pesticides, and the loss of wildflowers. Scientists and farmers are now planting bee-friendly gardens and reducing harmful chemicals to help protect these important insects.
